title: Localize ReminderMessage.build's title/body via string resources
name: build
description: This builds the actual notification title/body the user sees, so it needs a Context to resolve the new parameterized reminder_title/reminder_text string resources. Both call sites (DailyListViewModel.logDose, BootReminderReceiver) are updated separately to pass a context.
acceptance_criteria: Signature becomes build(context: Context, medicationName: String, dueAtEpochMillis: Long): Pair<String, String>
The per-call fresh SimpleDateFormat (not cached) is unchanged, per the existing thread-safety comment
